title: Housekeeping - Room Attendant
description: Housekeeping Room Attendant Location: LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort, Windsor, SL4 4AY Hours: Full time, any 5 days out of 7, Shifts will cover hours between 09:00am - 3:30pm (average hours per week will be 27.5) Contract Type: Seasonal, until January 2027 We are recruiting for Room Attendants to join our AWESOME Hotel Housekeeping Team! Our Housekeeping Room Attendants look after our beautifully themed hotel rooms across all 3 of our resort accommodations, cleaning and prepping them for our guests before their arrival and after their checkout. This is a hands-on role with lots of physical movement and heavy lifting, and you’ll have the opportunity to create special and memorable guest interactions as you work across our Hotels. Our overnight guests have an extra special touch of magic on their visit to LEGOLAND Windsor Resort, and you will play a key part in making sure their stay is Brick-tastic, with a beautifully clean and well-presented room to greet them after a long day of experiencing our rides, attractions and shows! Qualifications & Experience Having experience of working as a cleaner within a fast-paced hotel environment is desirable however we will provide you with all of the training you need to succeed in this role! All we need from you is a positive outlook on learning and a keen eye for high cleanliness standards We’d love it if you have a keen eye for detail, and of course high standards of cleanliness This is a physical role so you must be comfortable to be on your feet for long periods of time, and comfortable with heavy lifting, bending and reaching Benefits 40% discount off LEGO® sets and products on the online LEGO Store! Merlin Magic Pass: 20 free tickets for you, your family and friends to enjoy all of our Merlin Attractions across the world! 25% discount in Merlin retail shops and restaurants (a brilliant extra treat when you’re using your Magic Pass to visit!) Staff discount codes for Merlin Annual Passes to gift to loved ones! Pro rata holiday allowance based on 28 days full time equivalent Private pension scheme Life assurance scheme Employee assistance programme Access to Perks at Work which 30,000+ national & local employee discounts Free staff parking Ongoing training & development About The LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort We are looking for Housekeeping Room Attendants to join our AWESOME team at the UK’s favourite children’s theme park; the LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort. The LEGOLAND Windsor Resort is the ultimate destination for families with children age 2-12. The Resort is home to three awesome LEGO themed Hotels and a host of rides, shows and attractions built around the iconic LEGO® brick. This role is based at the Windsor theme park, located in 150 acres of beautiful parkland. About Merlin A job with Merlin isn’t like a job anywhere else. With attractions around the world, from rollercoasters to wax figures, we don’t trade in suits, handshakes or briefcases. We trade in fun. In smiles, shrieks and spine-tingles. In Memories. In magic. But there are no tricks behind our magic. Instead, there are people like you. Passionate, dedicated people who are committed to making sure our worldwide attractions and guests’ experiences are the best they can be. If you have any questions or if you require any assistance, because of a disability or medical condition, please contact us by email at recruitment@merlinentertainments.biz and one of the team will get back to you as soon as possible. Pay Range GBP £12.77/Hr.
